identity.title: Move RecipeCommandSurface WPF image-file decoding to the existing preview factory

origin.kind: explicit user request to continue RecipeCommandSurface refactoring
origin.summary: The final PL-0025 audit found four repeated WPF image-file decoding sites in RecipeCommandSurface: one locator overlay BitmapImage loader and three BitmapFrame dimension reads. The existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory is a concrete UI image owner that can absorb these operations without a new abstraction layer.

state.current_summary: PL-0026 resolved: repeated WPF image-file decoding moved to the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory, the Surface retained its BitmapSource/state/status contracts, focused image and regression contracts passed, Debug builds passed with zero warnings/errors, and the final owner audit is recorded.

objective.summary: Move WPF BitmapImage/BitmapFrame file decoding out of RecipeCommandSurface into the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory while preserving overlay validation errors, ROI dimension behavior, status handling, and the existing XAML BitmapSource property contract.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; keep C:\Git\2D\Original read-only.
Do not reopen or repeat PL-0022, PL-0023, PL-0024, or PL-0025.
Reuse the existing concrete OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory; do not add an interface, manager, provider, wrapper, or manual partial.
Preserve existing missing-file and decode exception behavior so current status/error projections remain unchanged.
Keep RecipeCommandSurface responsible for recipe state, intent validation, status projection, and XAML BitmapSource binding; the factory owns only WPF file image decoding.
Do not move unrelated File.Exists, Path, XML, or recipe/pipeline storage policy in this slice.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or modify Original from this refactoring slice.

criteria.text: The current and intended image-decoding owner, callers, dependency direction, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, XAML contract, and shortest reading route are documented from source.

RecipeCommandSurface contains no direct BitmapImage or BitmapFrame file-decoding calls; the existing preview factory owns path decoding and pixel-size reads while Surface retains the BitmapSource binding property and state projection.

Focused image factory and Surface regression contracts prove valid path decoding, pixel-size reads, missing-file failure, and existing RecipeCommandSurface callback/status contracts; required Debug builds pass.
Handoff and codebase navigation record the image boundary, preserved public/XAML contracts, first-contributor route, changed files, and remaining File/XML policy; runtime UI limits are explicit.

milestones.summary: Audit repeated WPF image-file decoding and prove the existing factory as the smallest owner.
Extend the existing preview factory and route overlay/dimension reads through it without changing state or binding contracts.
Run focused image and RecipeCommandSurface regression contracts and Debug builds.
Complete owner, MVVM, partial/folder, navigation, and first-contributor audit.

artifacts.summary: Focused evidence for the RecipeCommandSurface WPF image-file boundary.

evidence.observation: The source audit records one BitmapImage overlay loader and three BitmapFrame pixel-size reads in RecipeCommandSurface. The owner map shows the shared file-image decoding responsibility, the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory owner, the preserved BitmapSource XAML/state contract, and the explicit exclusion of unrelated recipe/file policy.

OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory now contains CreateFromPath and ReadPixelSize. RecipeCommandSurface routes the former overlay and three dimension reads through those methods; a direct BitmapImage/BitmapFrame.Create/BitmapCacheOption search in the Surface is clear. BitmapSource and its XAML property remain as the protected presentation contract. No new abstraction or partial was added.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke x64 Debug and OpenVisionLab.sln Debug builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Copied-runtime image factory contract passed 4/4, Dispatcher regression 2/2, Clipboard regression 3/3, RefreshOptions 1/1, Validation Set success 1/1, and Validation Set error 1/1. The image contract verified frozen OnLoad preview, pixel dimensions, and missing-file failure behavior. Desktop WPF, device, and long-run limits remain unverified.

The final audit records the existing preview-factory owner, four changed call paths, frozen OnLoad lifetime, preserved BitmapSource/XAML and status contracts, no manual partial/folder or new abstraction, and the remaining multi-owner File/XML policy. Documentation index, RefactorAudit, readiness, issue-ledger validation, and git diff checks passed; M3 contains the final zero-warning Debug builds and copied-runtime contracts. Actual WPF visual and long-running runtime matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: Extend the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory with path preview and pixel-size operations, then route all four Surface decode sites through it. Keep Surface state/status/XAML ownership and leave unrelated storage policy unchanged.

Reuse the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory directly instead of adding callbacks or a new image service. Its frozen OnLoad path preview and pixel-size methods preserve the old exceptions and caller behavior.

Keep the factory-only image boundary after valid path, frozen OnLoad, pixel-size, and missing-file contracts passed; preserve the existing Surface status and validation flows and claim no unrun desktop UI matrix.

Close the image boundary: the existing preview factory owns file-backed WPF decode and pixel-size reads, Surface retains state/status/XAML ownership, and unrelated storage policy remains untouched until a separate owner proof exists.

PL-0026 resolved after all four milestones and criteria were evidenced. No further RecipeCommandSurface split is justified by this source audit; reopen only for a new independent boundary, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency contract.
